data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 甜品店的身高悲剧
data.description: 高级甜品店，她踩在椅子上才够到吧台点单，被店员问「小朋友一个人吗」后周身爆发出低气压；最后买走了最贵的蛋糕——用大人的方式回击。
data.action: 高级甜品店，她踩在椅子上才够到吧台点单，被店员问「小朋友一个人吗」后周身爆发出低气压
data.promptProse: At the elegant dessert counter, Tatsumaki stands on a chair to order, green curls framing an indignant look at the clerk's mistaken greeting. Her moss-green cardigan, cream top and ankle-length black skirt stay tidy beside the expensive cake she chooses. The medium view includes the display case and counter height. Shop lights brighten cake glaze and cardigan knit, leaving compact shadows beneath the chair and soft reflections in the glass.
